analysis.reason: RSI 44에서 53.3으로 회복하며 과매도 구간 탈출 확인. MACD 히스토그램도 음수에서 양수로 전환하며 개선세 지속. 5일 저가 대비 20일 저가가 높아 Higher Low 패턴 형성 중. 거래량도 5일 평균 대비 1.23배로 증가하며 상승 모멘텀 강화.
analysis.reasonEn: RSI recovered from 44 to 53.3, confirming exit from oversold territory. MACD histogram also turned positive from negative, continuing its improvement. The 5-day low is higher than the 20-day low, forming a Higher Low pattern. Trading volume increased by 1.23 times the 5-day average, strengthening upward momentum.

analysis.narrativeEn:

· Position relative to SMA100 ($533.65)/SMA200 ($432.54) - Mixed signals for long-term trend.
· 52-week position (68.4%) + Current price range in a pullback from historical highs.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (44.0→52.0) + Entering neutral zone after exiting oversold + Upward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-1.1778→1.0828) + Diagnosing improvement + Confirmation of trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near middle band $523.37) + Interpreting normal band width.
[Support & Resistance]
· Swing support ($522.24) + Based on SMA20.
· Swing resistance ($533.74) + Potential for strengthening uptrend upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Forming Higher Low) + Diagnosing recovery signal.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.23x 5-day average) + Increased reliability of price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Early stage of uptrend) + 1x target allocation filled, leverage to be considered on signal strengthening.
